payload.core_mechanism_summary: Check prefix and suffix equality, then sort both subarrays in [l, r] to compare multiset equality, printing TRUTH if all match, else LIE.
payload.rationale: The solution uses sorting to verify that the subarray in the given range contains the same multiset of numbers, allowing arbitrary reordering. No custom key is used, but among given subtypes, sorting_custom_key is the closest match; sweep line and binary search are not applicable.
